card.name: Under the tongue and other body-site phrases
card.fires_on: The word completing a short phrase in instructions, most often "tongue" (or Spanish "lengua") after "under the". It also fires on a few other phrase-ending words such as "over" before a time, "with" and "finger".

modes.label: Under the tongue
modes.description: Spray or dosing directions where the product goes under the tongue, in English or Spanish.
modes.example: Hold close to mouth and spray under the<< tongue>> as directed by a healthcare professional.

modes.label: Spanish tongue word
modes.description: The end of the Spanish word lengua in bajo la lengua.
modes.example: Aplique directamente bajo la leng<<ua>> segun indicacion medica.

modes.label: Other instruction phrases
modes.description: Scattered linking or phrase-ending words in administration instructions and methods.
modes.example: Avoid direct contact<< with>> broken or crushed tablets or oral suspension.
